params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.grouped_entry
params.description: Output only. If the table is a dated shard, i.e., with name pattern [prefix]YYYYMMDD, grouped_entry is the Data Catalog resource name of the date sharded grouped entry, for example, projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/entrygroups/{entry_group_id}/entries/{entry_id}. Otherwise, grouped_entry is empty.
